remarks: Welcome to 97 Richards Ave Unit B2 - Your Modern Urban Oasis in Norwalk, CT. Step into contemporary living at its finest in this beautifully designed condominium, ideally situated in the heart of Norwalk. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers 1,196 square feet of thoughtfully crafted living space, blending style, comfort, and functionality. The spacious living area is bathed in natural light, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Step outside to your private deck, where you can unwind and enjoy the serene surroundings. Retreat to the primary suite, a peaceful haven with a private en-suite bath for added convenience and luxury. The second bedroom is versatile, quickly transforming into a guest room, home office, or personal sanctuary to suit your lifestyle. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry facilities and ample storage space, making everyday living effortless. Located in vibrant Norwalk, this home puts you steps away from top-rated dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Immerse yourself in the community's energy while enjoying the comfort of your private retreat. The property Does need some TLC.
